name: provemark/content-credentials
description: PHP library for C2PA Content Credentials: build, sign, read and verify manifests, with machine-readable marking of AI-generated content (EU AI Act, Article 50).

suggest.illuminate/support: Required only to use the Laravel service provider and facade (provided by any Laravel app).
suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: A PSR-18 client + PSR-17 factories for the signing client outside Laravel (any PSR-18/PSR-17 implementation works).
suggest.ext-c2pa: Read C2PA credentials in-process with ExtC2paReader, without running the signing service (pie install ericmann/ext-c2pa; v0.1.0 at time of writing)

scripts-descriptions.format: Fix code style with Laravel Pint
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Static analysis with PHPStan (level max; needs more than PHP's default 128M, which crashes a parallel worker)
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the Pest test suite (excludes the service-dependent integration group; run it with: vendor/bin/pest --group=integration)
scripts-descriptions.check: The single definition of green: format + analyse + test + deptrac. Keeps the output of a FAILING run at out/check-<stamp>.log; a green run leaves nothing.
scripts-descriptions.check:run: The check sequence itself, without the failure-capture wrapper. Use `check`.
